pkgmetadata.longdescription: Mister Download Manager is a download manager written in Rust, laid out the way Internet Download Manager users expect: several connections per file, resume, queues, a scheduler, browser capture, video pages through yt-dlp, galleries and torrents. This package builds the firesand fork, which adds two capabilities of the Plexo download manager written for its engine: Combine networks, where a download goes through several network connections at once with a speed limit and data allowance for each, and Usenet downloads from NZB files. Includes the command line, the browsers' native messaging host and the MCP server.
